collection.title: Audi A6/S6/RS6 Avant 2018 to 2023 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Audi A6 Avant 2018 - 2023 which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this A6 Avant which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below. Please Note: These wiper blades are not suitable for models with built in Washer Jets.
